goal: SOTA BPC for autoregressive char-level text generation on enwik8 (target <= 1.05 BPC) and text8 (target <= 1.05 BPC).

budget_locked.note: LOCKED after iter-13/iter-14 search. 30M chars >> 10M (2.2486->1.8869). block_size 512 beats 1024 at both 10M (2.2597 vs 2.5418) and 30M (1.8869 vs 1.9812). DO NOT push more compute budget to chase BPC; improvements must be architectural.

current_best.notes: Progression: 3.493 (baseline) -> ... -> 2.2878 (d1024) -> 2.2597 (block512, relu2+softcap) -> 2.2486 (10M best) -> 1.8869 (30M, relu2, softcap, block512, window128) -> 1.8833 (iter-15: + token-window warmup 32->128 over first 12 ep). Run bsggqgae (v23) completed clean 40/40 at locked 30M/512 budget in 58.7 min. Warmup gave a small gain (1.8869->1.8833) and confirmed the locked config reproduces. val/loss still drifting down ~0.003/ep at E40 so headroom is architectural, not budget.

historical_source.note: Provenance kept for the agent's startup context. Identifiers (kernel slug, W&B entity/project/sweep/run) are NOT committed publicly in the mirror — supplied via GHA env vars. Treat as opaque labels here.

sota_reference.note: SOTA targets here are ballpark recent transformer-class results; the canonical target is improving on the user's own current best BPC, then chasing published SOTA.

next_iteration_directions: Iter-16 (next push): bigram-hash byte embedding (modded-nanogpt rec 62) at locked 30M/512 budget — hash-trick bigram lookup added to the input embedding (bigram_buckets=8192, bigram_dim=96). Cheap, TPU-safe, directly applicable to byte vocab=257. Builds on iter-15's window-warmup (1.8833 BPC, new best).
After bigram-hash, layer the next cheap modded-nanogpt wins one at a time: QK-norm on chunk/token attention (record 5), gated value-skip from compressor output to chunk-decoder output (record 55).
Evaluate Muon optimizer on 2D weights (record 1) — highest leverage but biggest risk on TF/TPU; only after warmup+QK-norm are validated.
Add ModelCheckpoint every epoch + resume-on-restart so a TPU session timeout never loses progress.
Add a true text8 evaluation path (alternative corpus to cross-validate generalization).
Re-enable the online W&B sweep (RUN_MODE=sweep_online_single_agent) over lr/batch_size/weight_decay once the locked-budget architecture stack is stable.
